high_level_description: The image is a news report about a tornado that touched down in Boyle Heights on Christmas Day. The top part of the image contains a text update from the National Weather Service (NWS). It states that an EF-0 tornado caused damage including damaged roofs, broken windows, and debris. The tornado occurred at 10:10 a.m. with winds up to 80 mph. The NWS notes that the tornado's path was about a quarter-mile long and had a width of 30 yards.
